But outside of work, when you can choose who you will spend your time with, what kind of people do you choose? Have you chosen people who are similar to yourself, or do you hang out with people who are your total opposite?","l":"\n","a":[["class","TNI"]]},{"n":"p","x":"Of course, there are no right or wrong answers, but it’s interesting to think about it.
